description: This file defines the SetServiceFields class, which implements a MethodOperation for handling the `<set-service-fields>` element in the OFBiz Mini-language. It provides functionality to gather input maps, expand service names, retrieve model service definitions, validate and set service attributes, and populate output maps based on a specified mode.

classes.name: SetServiceFields
classes.description: Implements the <set-service-fields> element as a method operation to set fields for a service invocation with validation, error handling, and proper map management.

classes.name: SetServiceFields.SetServiceFieldsFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of SetServiceFields based on XML element configuration.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Performs an auto-correction of the element if the 'error-list-name' attribute is present, removing it and indicating correction.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves the source map, expands service name, retrieves the model service, validates and filters input attributes, and populates the target map, handling errors appropriately.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, namely the service name, for documentation or auditing purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the SetServiceFields instance for debugging or logging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a SetServiceFields object based on an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this operation element, 'set-service-fields'.
